description: The Mvouni campus action on 2 January is reported as a strike/demonstration, but no source gives its public attendance or establishes the 50-person threshold. Enrollment totals are not attendance.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous attendance estimates or direct reporting that distinguishes the demonstrators from the wider student body; leave the threshold unresolved if no evidence exists.

description: The student dispute continued into a 9 January escalation, gendarmerie meeting and ministry delegation. Available reports do not establish whether these were a second public assembly or only negotiations, nor when the 2 January physical action ended.
required_followup: Compare reports around 2–16 January and the adjacent month; separate the 2 January event from later episodes only when a distinct public assembly is documented.

description: The two opened student reports are both by MasiwaKomor / Hachim Mohamed. Eurecanews and Al-Fajr leads were not body-verified, so independent corroboration is limited.
required_followup: Identify independent contemporaneous reporting or university records; do not treat repeated wording across search results as independent confirmation.

description: Sellers gathered outside Moroni city hall on 30 January, but attendance is unreported. Market stoppage duration, affected sellers, tables and stalls cannot be used as the number assembled.
required_followup: Seek independent contemporaneous coverage or a named source giving attendance at the city-hall gathering; do not derive a count from the market workforce.

description: Sellers’ account of changed fee assessment/payment differs from the municipal representative’s explanation. The Gazette issue reports a separate municipal press conference about unregistered tables and fee revenue but does not report the sellers’ gathering.
required_followup: Locate the fee schedule or an independent account clarifying which fee rule changed; keep both reported versions attributed until resolved.

description: The Mutsamudu port labor action involved dockers and truck drivers, but the state-policy/employer relationship is unresolved. A quoted driver calls on the government; the article does not establish whether disputed employment and pay terms were governed by state policy.
required_followup: Verify the port company’s status and whether demands concerned state labor policy; apply the manual’s exclusion for company-specific negotiations unless a public event or state-policy demand is established.

description: The 1 February Gazette report describes a roughly 20-day Mutsamudu truck-driver strike and dockworker dispute, but gives no participant count or public assembly evidence. Staffing figures in the article are not attendance.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous counts of people participating in a public protest event and determine whether at least 50 gathered; do not count workers merely affected by or absent from work.

description: The Mutsamudu strike was still described as active in a 1 February issue, so it appears to cross into February. Its exact start, physical end and continuation are unresolved.
required_followup: Search February 2023 local coverage for the strike’s closure or renewed episodes; retain January as the owner only if the January start is confirmed.

description: The opposition-front press-conference report is search-only and carries “©CMM”; its original source and ownership are unresolved. The Comores Infos archive listing does not establish independent confirmation.
required_followup: Resolve the CMM source/origin from saved source records or locate an independent contemporaneous report before using the article as corroboration; do not open the ambiguous source or a republication until reviewed.

description: The 26 January Iconi opposition-front press conference has no attendance figure or evidence of a public gathering of 50 or more. The original codebook excludes political rallies, and the available record does not resolve whether this was a press briefing or rally.
required_followup: Find an independent account of the meeting’s public format, attendance and purpose, then apply the codebook’s political-rally exclusion.

description: The AP/Africa-Press teacher-stoppage coverage is under the inherited publisher hold. No body was requested, and no syndication copy was used to bypass the hold.
required_followup: Use a separately sourced contemporaneous report or primary document to determine whether the announced stoppage occurred; leave attendance and public-assembly status unknown if no permitted source is found.

description: A 31 January Iconi/Malouzouni story is visible only as an archive/search-result title. Its body and direct article URL were not recovered, and the headline alone does not prove a gathering or violence.
required_followup: Identify the direct article URL through a permitted source review, then verify whether a public action occurred, its date/location, participant size and domestic state target; do not infer violence from the headline.

description: No event-specific state response is established for the four retained leads. Silence in the reviewed sources is not evidence of ignore; administrative meetings and prospective discussions are not coded as accommodation without event-linked evidence.
required_followup: Seek event-specific reports of accommodation, arrests, beatings, dispersal, ignore, killings or shootings; preserve unknown values where no direct evidence is found.

description: Discovery was predominantly French, with English and Arabic searches and one keyword-level “Shikomori” query. No robust Comorian-language search vocabulary or local-language archive pass was completed.
required_followup: With reliable language terms, search Comorian-language outlets and archives by week, island and sector; do not infer absence from the single Shikomori query.

description: The bounded open-web pass included weekly searches, local/regional outlets, event-specific searches, and official/human-rights queries, but found no contemporaneous official record of these events. The later State Department annual report is contextual and not date-specific. LexisNexis-equivalent coverage was unavailable.
required_followup: Compare accessible local archive issues and any official university, municipal or labor documents, and record the open-web/LexisNexis coverage difference; do not claim exhaustive coverage or that an unreported event did not occur.

description: Eurecanews and Al-Fajr student pages were not recovered: the web tool returned Cache miss/inaccessible responses and same-URL retries failed DNS before HTTP. Al-Fajr’s Volo Volo archive page also failed technically. These were not publisher denials.
required_followup: Use only if further independent detail would change coding; every retry needs a fresh exact-URL receipt. Do not treat technical failures as denials or requery merely to repair capture.
